name: Bangkok: City of Legends
storyline:
After arriving in Bangkok, the player is robbed on the chaotic streets of Khao San Road. A chance encounter with Paddy, the sharp-eyed barman of a local Irish pub, draws them into a web of unpaid debts, missing people, eccentric travelers, police trouble, and dangerous nightlife.
As the player explores Bangkok, they build relationships, navigate rival factions, uncover other people’s secrets, and decide what kind of traveler they want to become. Every conversation and choice can open new opportunities, close off others, and shape the story’s outcome.
summary: Bangkok City of Legends is a choice-driven narrative RPG set in the vibrant streets and nightlife of Bangkok. Explore the city, meet memorable characters, complete quests, and make decisions that shape your relationships, reputation, story, and ending.
